title: CultureScope: A Dimensional Lens for Probing Cultural Understanding in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on a custom dimensional benchmark (CultureScope) that includes 'Mislead' type questions (multiple-choice, true/false, short-answer) designed to test whether models can identify cultural misunderstandings, oversimplifications, stereotypes, and biases within specific cultural contexts (Chinese and Spanish).
